title: Form A — Follow choices through institutions
review_type: Specialist author mathematical, incentive, accounting and assessment-design review; root independently audits, integrates and alone accepts

format.conditions: Closed notes and solutions, basic nonprogrammable calculator, no external inputs or code execution
format.suggested_time: 32 minutes per domain plus 20 minutes to check

reviewed.scope_and_prerequisites: Read the fixed assessment assignment, canonical current Volume 5 entries, prerequisite manuscripts for the selected mechanisms and the earlier assessment conventions. The form follows all five frozen domain allocations. The twelve chapter methods are written and root-read; their final closing-batch and volume acceptance remains root-owned. No central acceptance claim or status edit is made by this package.
reviewed.originality_and_distinctness: Original combined cases test transfer rather than repeat a chapter exercise. D1 uses an unequal-share cubic utility representation, exact finite compensation versus an old basket, and a separate conditional-input production model. D2 joins a tax resource ledger to endowment-dependent exchange and an off-equilibrium Walras calculation. D3 moves from asymmetric active firms to a new observed two-entry-mode tree with three normal-form equilibria and one credible plan. D4 changes seller composition and then changes output rewards enough to reverse the principal's preferred effort while wage feasibility remains unchanged. D5 compares instrument administration and financing, supplies an arbitrary-threshold auction argument, and evaluates two positive dated voucher streams with nonunit exponential discounting and actual-versus-predicted continuation. The Form B allocated principal mechanisms—corners/revealed preference, opening-fee shutdown, alternative intervention or production ownership, discrimination/mixing, signaling/audit, public goods/congestion, matching and assigned/reference-dependent behavior—are not duplicated as this form's principal cases.
reviewed.reasoning_and_global_checks: Every numerical task is fully specified with its domain, timing, units, relevant outside option and permitted instrument. Positive prices and wealth support interior consumer demand; the cubic objective and expenditure function are checked globally, including boundaries. Convex cost and completed-square profits justify production. The exchange argument uses actual endowment wealth and a first-welfare expenditure contradiction, not an inference from Walras law alone. Cournot checks nonnegative active sets and the zero-price region. The entry solution supplies each off-path plan and distinguishes Nash from subgame perfection. Lemons prices are checked against alternative offers. The wage result uses both IR and IC global cost bounds and an explicit tie convention. Externality receipts, permit rents, transfers and real administration remain distinct. Auction truthfulness is proved weakly for arbitrary rival thresholds, and behavioral welfare criteria are explicitly different from the action rule.
reviewed.solutions_and_scoring: Reviewed all twenty exact prompts against their worked solutions and five-point rubrics. The HTML checker verifies every matching answer ID and every rubric's component sum, twenty parts, five domains and 100 total points. Follow-through is allowed for arithmetic slips without awarding incorrect constraint or interpretation claims. Critical-error criteria explicitly cover infeasible/local optima, omitted wealth, transfer/resource confusion, profitable deviations and incredible threats, IR-only effort reasoning, rent/risk confusion, selection and unsupported welfare/causal conclusions. All open interpretive requirements include concrete acceptable reasoning; alternative correct methods receive credit.
reviewed.workload: All cases use supplied finite tables, one-variable derivatives or two linear equations, small exact fractions and square/cubic certificates already taught. There is no general matching incentive theorem, revenue-equivalence derivation, stochastic estimation task or required software run. The form assigns a 32-minute domain budget and 20-minute checking reserve; this is a design estimate, not empirical learner timing validation. Questions and data are separate from the full hidden solutions.
reviewed.sources: Reused stable previously inspected primary-method routes through all twelve Volume 5 chapters, each linked from the form. No new historical, empirical, institutional or legal claim was introduced, so no new browsing or source proposal was required. The exam's numerical economies, terminal payoffs and behavioral flows are synthetic and explicitly labeled. Source inspection of the chapter methods does not establish empirical effects for these assumed examples.
reviewed.structure_and_ownership: Static HTML fragment with h2#form-a, five question groups, twenty five-point parts, twenty matching complete answers and rubrics, one captioned entry table and uniquely prefixed internal IDs. No h1, new asset, external service, framework or dependency was introduced. Only the three assigned Form A paths were written. Root owns the assembled volume assessment, common advancement protocol, cross-form comparison, shared build/checkpoint and publication.

validation.integration_api: check() is quiet and directly JSON serializable without a fallback serializer; the CLI prints JSON. Explicit require() validations remain active under optimized Python. Relative artifact paths resolve from the script, not the process working directory.
independent_paths: Factorized cubic utility and rational compensation gaps independently supplement derivative solutions
Integrate benefit and cost rather than only repeat consumer/producer surplus triangles
Clear the exchange y market independently of the manuscript's x equation and verify off-equilibrium value identities
Enumerate Cournot active sets and unilateral deviations, including output beyond the demand intercept
Read the actual HTML entry table and enumerate normal-form and proper-subgame best responses
Check seller participation and alternative buyer offers; solve exact wage constraint intersections rather than reuse the analytic cost formula

limitations: Author/root review is internal and does not constitute independent human academic certification or empirical difficulty/time validation.
Finite numerical grids supplement exact analytic proofs and the separate complete manuscript audit; grids alone do not establish universal optimality or incentive results.
The welfare comparisons use supplied quasilinear, resource-accounting or temporal criteria. They are not universal normative rankings or empirical intervention estimates.
All populations, technologies, games, probabilities and dated utility flows are synthetic; real data, enforcement and identification require separate evidence.
The contracting conclusions use stated weak-action/acceptance ties. The entry exercise asks for pure Nash and subgame-perfect profiles, not every mixed equilibrium.
No browser visual/mobile/print QA was performed; the recorded preview restriction remains respected.
Root retains full manuscript audit, cross-form distinctness, final chapter/package acceptance, integration and publication.
handoff: Complete bounded Form A draft package ready for root's independent audit and coherent-batch integration; no shared state, other assignment, commit or publication changed.
